thread:
Elaine V.: quick design review — model catalog compare table: performance badges are currently high-contrast blue and live left of the row. Users keep missing the version pin state and pin isn't prominent when comparing versions. Thinking: move perf badge to rightmost cell, add small 'Pinned' chip to the left of the version pill, and reduce badge saturation. Also need to address screen-reader order so 'Pinned' announced first. Link to mock: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/model-catalog-mockups

Sam K.: I like moving the pinned chip earlier in reading order :thumbsup: One concern — badges are used for perf snappiness (green/yellow/red). If we desaturate them they lose meaning. Maybe move but keep strong color; de-emphasize with a subtle outline and smaller size.

Mike R.: A11y note — reordering visually with CSS (order) doesn't change DOM order for AT. If we want SR to announce 'Pinned' first, put it earlier in the DOM and use CSS to reorder visually. Also add aria-label to the badge: aria-label="performance: 92 percentile". For keyboard, ensure pin has tabindex=0 and a "Press Enter to toggle pin" aria-describedby.

Ana (PM): Quick product question — should pinned state persist when filters change? Users expect pin to be per-model-and-version and survive search, but that could be confusing in compare mode. My preference: persist across filters but show a small toast when the view changes to explain context.

Jordan - FE: technical note — moving DOM nodes is heavier but doable. Alternative: keep DOM order (Pinned chip first), and visually float the perf badge to the right via flex and justify-content. We need to audit cell renderers; this change will touch ~3 components. Can ship as behind a feature flag.

Elaine V.: Proposed microcopy for tooltip on Pinned: "Pinned — will stay visible in your compare until unpinned." For perf badge tooltip: "Latency percentile vs baseline". Thoughts?

Sam K.: Microcopy tweaks: make Pinned tooltip actionable: "Pinned — stays in compare. Press Esc to close." For perf: "Latency percentile vs baseline (lower is better)". Add hidden text for screen readers: "Performance: 92nd percentile; color green".

DesignBot: Accessibility checklist update:
- DOM order: Pinned chip before version (done)
- aria-labels for badges (todo)
- keyboard focus + key handlers for pin (todo)
- color contrast tests for badge variants (todo)
- run VoiceOver + NVDA test on Mac/Windows (todo)

Elaine V.: Okay — next steps: Jordan to prototype DOM change behind flag; Mike to draft aria strings; Sam/Ana to finalize microcopy; I'll update figma and file a small PM ticket for persistence behavior. Plan to test in next week.

Sam K.: sounds good. :thumbsup:
